name: GitHub
description: Official GitHub integration for Chattree. Inspect repositories, list your projects, view issues, and manage tokens using natural language or slash commands.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.0.5: Added built-in natural language intent processing in WASM. Supports queries like '/github que repos tengo', '/github quien soy', '/github mis repos', issues and pull requests.

tools.description: Interactúa con GitHub en lenguaje natural o con comandos: /github que repos tengo, /github quien soy, /github <owner/repo>, /github issues <owner/repo>, o /github config <token>.
